sites.name: calc
sites.summary: A calc rule's reduce: one value of the output key's type, from the rule's aliased inputs on one owner. The output key types the result, so a key is required.

variants.when: a string or json property output

sites.bindings: Each of the rule's inputs by its alias, as the list of its current values, typed by its key (a metric is a number, a property text, a bool property a bool). For a component owner, one value per instance: the named instances, the aggregate instance only when it is the key's one, an instance not heard from in an hour left out. For a system owner, every role-bound member's values, ordered by member name then id; and members: one record per member, holding id, name, value.<alias> (the member's own current value, the type's zero when it has none) and has.<alias> (whether it holds one), so one member's inputs stay together. A list function (avg, max, min, sum, majority, any, all) folds a list into one value.
